Armour and Weapons
​
Armour
General Armour Introduction
⬥ There are three categories of armour:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Power: any armour with a style bonus
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Hybrid: anything stated as "hybrid"
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tank: any other item (also has more armour than power / hybrid)
⬥ Armour tiers are based on the level required to equip them
⬥ Equipping armour provides style and armour bonuses
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These bonuses are based on armour category and tier
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Generally armours in the same category and tier will have equal bonuses
⬥ Wearing off-style armour slots (excluding cape slot) provides an accuracy penalty based on armour bonus
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• "Off-style" is any style that does not match your equipped main hand / 2H weapon
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Hybrid gear incurs no penalty
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This penalty is near-doubled (0.8 → 1.5) when using the Necromancy combat style.
⬥ Some armour sets have set effects which may be useful

















Index of Armour

⬥ It is recommended to look up further information on the Wiki
⬥ Armour in bold is worth being aware of, they will be elaborated on after or are recommended in the respective upgrade order
⬥ Use !armour to see DPS difference between the armour
⬥ Generally speaking, use power armour

Weapons
General Weapons Introduction
⬥ The tier of a weapon is the listed equip requirement. Generally the damage and accuracy tier match that
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Exceptions include:  (T90 damage, T75 accuracy), GWD2 weapons (T80 damage, T90 accuracy), and   (T88 damage, T85 accuracy)
⬥ For dual-wield weapons:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Overall damage tier is equal to 66% of the main hand's tier and 33% of the off-hand's tier
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Overall accuracy tier you have is equal to your main hand's tier fully.
⬥ For ammo'd  weapons and  weapons:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Damage tier is equal to the minimum between the weapon tier and the ammo / spell tier
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ E.g. a T90 weapon with a T1 ammo / spell has T1 damage

Defenders and Shields

















Defenders and Shields

⬥ It is recommended to look up further information on the Wiki
⬥ Use !defender for info on obtaining defenders
⬥ Defender weapon and shield tier is half its tier (e.g. T90 defender is T45)
⬥ Defenders provide 3% accuracy and 1/15 chance to reduce hit by 50-100%
⬥ T90 shields' right-click voke option drops target when using queueing
⬥ Spirit shields reduce damage by 30%, 20% of it is removed from prayer
⬥ Shieldbows count as a MH + shield of its tier (e.g.  is a T70 MH + shield)
⬥ Bone shield  /  is unlocked via  and allows the use of defensive shield abilities without a physical shield, costing necrotic runes.
    • With lvl120 ,  and  you can reach up to bone shield tier 75.

Rings

















Rings

⬥ Use !ring to see when to use what ring
⬥ Rings covered:  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  | 
⬥  +  can be imbued for +2.5 style bonus at the Armoursmith for teci

Ring of Death 
⬥ On target death, 50% chance to gain 1% adren per 1.5k hp of it (caps at 5%)
⬥ On player death, the player is revived at full health and a damage-over-time effect is applied for three minutes
⬥ Overchargeable at Death for 5 cut onyx and 25  (has 5x charges)
Channeler's Ring 
⬥ Each hit of a  channel has (4 * channel hits done)% more crit chance
⬥ Metaphysics enchantment causes +(2.5 * channel hits done) % crit dmg
⬥ To clarify:  and its enchantment only affect  channels, not autos, etc.
Champion's Ring 
⬥  attacks gain 3% (4% if heroism enchantment) crit chance if target bled
⬥ Heroism enchantment also adds (1.5 * bleed count)% crit damage
Stalker's Ring 
⬥ Bow attacks gain 3% (4% if shadow enchantment) crit chance
⬥ Shadow enchantment also adds 3% crit damage
Occultist's ring 
⬥ On cast, Necromancy attacks have a 10% chance to generate +2 stacks of Necrosis 
    • This does not affect conjure attacks or Bloat  after the first hit
Zorgoth's soul ring 
⬥ Upgraded from Zorgoth's ring (quest reward from Requiem for a Dragon) while wearing it during rituals at the Ungael ritual site.
⬥ Necromancy hits have a 5% chance to generate +1 stack of Residual Soul 
    • This does not affect conjure attacks or Bloat  after the first hit
    • AOE abilities like Blood Siphon  can proc for every target and every hit
Other Rings
⬥ Reaver's Ring  - +5% crit chance but -5% hitchance
⬥ Asylum Surgeon's Ring  - 30s cooldown if either occur:
    • 10% chance to prevent threshold cost
    • 40% chance to save 25% of spec cost
⬥ Ring of Vigour  - Ultimates refund 10% adren, spec cost reduced by 10%; this can be made passive via the Extinction quest

blocks.text: ⬥ There are three categories of armour:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Power: any armour with a style bonus
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tank: any other item (also has more armour than power / hybrid)
⬥ Armour tiers are based on the level required to equip them
⬥ Equipping armour provides style and armour bonuses
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These bonuses are based on armour category and tier
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Generally armours in the same category and tier will have equal bonuses
⬥ Wearing off-style armour slots (excluding cape slot) provides an accuracy penalty based on armour bonus
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• "Off-style" is any style that does not match your equipped main hand / 2H weapon
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This penalty is near-doubled (0.8 → 1.5) when using the Necromancy combat style.
⬥ Some armour sets have set effects which may be useful
